title: Not what I expected
text: Not what I expected. Smaller than expected. Can not use without lid. Ordered this for my mother because she has trouble gripping her drinks, but she doesn't like using lids. There are groves around the inner top of the cup to screw the lid on. I returned this.

product_metadata.title: Cicike 12oz. Coffee Travel Mug, Iced Coffee Tumbler with Lid, Thermal Coffee Mug with Silicone Sleeve for Easy to Grip, One-Handed Operation Reusable Coffee Cup, Keep Drinks Cold and Hot up to 6 Hours
features: [PORTABLE SIZE]: The 12 ounces(360ml) volume for easy carrying, this small travel mug fits most single-serve brewers and car cup holders

[ONE TOUCH TUMBLER]: One-handed operation with a flip lid for easy multitasking when your hands are full of other stuff, this insulated coffee mug also very convenient to drink with one hand while driving

[INSULATION INNOVATION]: Double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel keeps beverages hot or cold up to 6 hours in this travel cup, but still cool to touch on the outside, and will never get condensation due to its great insulation technology

[ECO FRIENDLY]: Made of non-leaching 18/8 food-grade stainless steel, that is also scratch and rust-resistant making it the perfect iced coffee tumbler, it has a stainless steel inner core to resist stains and odors, and a very comfortable silicone sleeve outside to give you a nice feel and grip

[LEAK PROOF]: The lid flap has sufficient friction to stop it from falling on your nose when you're tipping your head back to get your favorite drinks. The one-piece flip lid is easy to use and 100% leak-proof when snapped shut, and of course, this cute coffee mug is BPA free
